name: VHS Vibes
author: anthonytheinventor
summary: A worn video-tape effect: pitch wobble, tape saturation with tape hysteresis, the Hi-Fi track, generation loss, B-type noise reduction, hum, hiss and crackle, plus deck faults (level control, drift, tracking dropouts, a tilted head) and a dry/wet mix. 54 programs, on a hot pink cassette with reels that turn and a picture that shows the sound.
